hypothesis: Persistently higher call trading activity per outstanding contract than put activity contains a bullish information component beyond underlying price momentum. This is an untested directional hypothesis; gross activity does not identify buyer-initiated flow and may instead reflect hedging or writing.

proposed_definition.positive_direction: higher score predicts higher next-month total ETF return
proposed_definition.information_delay: historical timing subject to source qualification; never same-close execution
proposed_definition.position_policy: long or cash, existing CNY 1000 cap; maintain position while eligible, no forced monthly round trip
proposed_definition.costs: 0/5/10 CNY minimum commission and 0/10/30bp per-side slippage; 5 CNY and 10bp principal unconfirmed case
proposed_definition.comparison: cash and same-cap buy-and-hold, later exposure analysis; net EV not inferred from correlation

independence.primary_information: derivative call/put activity relative to each side's outstanding contracts
independence.method_limits: No equity return, signal, historical feature or parameter fitting in this source-only scope.
